description: This file defines the internal class 'GrainMethodInvoker' in the Orleans framework, responsible for invoking methods on grains, handling invocation filters, managing invocation stages, and executing the target grain method.

classes.name: GrainMethodInvoker
classes.description: Handles the invocation of a grain method, supporting invocation filters, managing invocation state, and response handling within the Orleans runtime.

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: Executes the invocation pipeline for a grain method, including calling filters, the grain itself, and handling responses and exceptions.

methods.name: GetMethodEntry
methods.description: Retrieves the implementation and interface method information for the current invocation.
